ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar examines the dramatic changes taking place in French art in the wake of the revolutions of 1848. We shall focus on the effect of political, social, and institutional developments on artistic practice, but we shall also explore in detail the production of key artists active during this period, including Courbet, Millet, Daumier, Delacroix, Ingres, and Manet. In the last four decades, scholarship in this area has produced prominent models for art historical interpretation (for example, T.J. Clark's two books on artistic responses to 1848), and we shall spend some time looking at what these offer in terms of method. Other authors whose work we shall read include Patricia Mainardi, Michael Marrinan, Linda Nochlin, Marc Gotlieb, Michael Fried, and Neil McWilliam.
